newsitem.title: CANADA: Asia Pacific up on speculation of deal.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pacific up on speculation of deal.

text.p: Asia Pacific Resources Ltd was up in heavy trading Friday morning as investors speculated about an announcement expected next week, the company said.
Shares in the Vancouver-based potash exploration company were up C$0.25 to C$10.65 with almost 1.4 million shares trading hands by midday.
The company has told investors it plans to make an announcement on Monday, said spokesman Anthony Petrovich.

Trading is heavy also because the company has said October 31 was a "soft deadline" for expressions of interest from companies wanting to enter into a joint venture with Asia Pacific or buy part of the company, Petrovich said.
He said he did not know if Monday's announcement would be about the expressions of interest or about an ongoing exploration program for potash in Thailand.
